# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 and performance** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates the engine to Skia milestone m151 and improves performance across frequently used APIs. Text shaping, tag parsing, color conversion, and premultiplication now avoid several allocations and native calls. WebAssembly also gains Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries for .NET 11.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Upgraded to Skia milestone m151** — The bundled engine moves to Skia m151 and includes four subsequent rounds of upstream Chrome m151 fixes. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))
- **CPU raster regression fixed** — Legacy shader-context support has been restored to correct CPU raster output affected by the engine upgrade. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## API Surface

- **SKColor parsing supports spans** — New ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads avoid string allocation at call sites while speeding up hexadecimal color parsing. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))
- **GRContextOptions no longer requires unsafe code** — Removing its unnecessary unsafe modifier lets consumers use GRContextOptions without enabling unsafe compilation. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Bug Fixes

- **Cropped image decode no longer leaks** — SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) now releases its native resource when the crop rectangle falls outside the image bounds. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **WebAssembly macro conflict removed** — The Skia submodule no longer redefines SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM in toolchains that already provide it. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3788](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3788))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Hot paths allocate less and avoid native calls** — Color conversion, premultiplication, tag parsing, UTF-8 text ingestion, and shaped-glyph access now use managed math, pooled encoding, or zero-copy spans. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))

## Platform

- **WebAssembly support prepared for .NET 11** — Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries support the new exnref exception model used by .NET 11 WebAssembly. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Text ingestion and tag parsing now avoid per-call allocations, while shaped-glyph results use zero-copy spans.
